title: The Balidiah Dam
author: Satya Sundar Samanta
text:
Under the high heaven in September
Hills are decorated with green attire,
Dewy, leafy banners
Sprightly move the tops
With pure country wind
That, then, turn towards vast land
Of water that mirrors
Wavy heaven and zigzag hills.
Feathers of multi hues
Fly and sit on red lilies,
Slow water overflowing the dam
Flows down towards the plain.

More curious eyes come
Only in wealthy seasons
Leave  non-degradable wastes
Behind mossy walls.
